text:
Fix prompt_structure_problems in crates/athena-core/src/mirrors.rs. Today glued_item only flags a glued '- ' item when the glued text starts with a lowercase 'word:' head, and joined_head only matches old heads word for word. So the h9ea candidate line in reader.md was not flagged: it was a reworded old bullet ending in 'assumptions.' followed directly by '- For CI caching ...'. Also flag a '- ' or '* ' that follows sentence-ending punctuation and is followed by an uppercase letter. Add a test that uses that exact line shape, and a test showing a hyphen inside ordinary prose is still not flagged. Acceptance: the mirrors test fails on the h9ea line shape; the existing mirrors tests still pass; cargo fmt --check, clippy and the full test suite pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Prompt-structure check missed a new bullet glued onto an old one in reader.md, so the job was rejected at the final verdict again
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
